title: Why nothing is done about the farming bots?

posts.cooked:
The problem of bot farms, especially groups of druids, has been plaguing the game for years now, and it’s only getting worse. We constantly see packs of druids exploiting fast spawn times, farming resources and mobs 24/7 without any visible consequences. This raises a few key questions:

  1. Why are druids the go-to for botting, and why hasn’t Blizzard done more to address this?
  2. Are fast respawn timers being exploited, and if so, why haven’t they been adjusted?
  3. How is Blizzard responding to the economic damage caused by bots flooding the market with resources?
  4. Why do bans seem so rare and ineffective at curbing the issue?
  5. Can Blizzard improve their bot detection systems, especially given modern advances in AI and machine learning?
  6. Is Blizzard even listening to the community’s frustration about botting, or is this issue being ignored?

It’s frustrating to see these bots continuing to thrive while legitimate players suffer. Will Blizzard finally step up and address this issue, or will the problem keep getting worse? The community needs answers and action.
